notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Fixed “Find a way inside mine” not showing on start
Fixed interact sometimes staying on at car door
Fixed interacting through gates
Fixed various crouching issues
Absolutely slaughtered the game tick time (fps go brrr)
Fixed monster being yeeted out of the map sometimes when touching chains
Fixed objects staying in hand when soul bonding
Fixed cabinet doors bouncing back open after shutting
Fixed ability to fire flare gun during its cutscene
Fixed settings not saving over to new game
Greatly lowered chance of hunt during parkour (lever C)
End chase appears to be working now
Chains slightly more likely to trigger hunt
Attempted fix for objects falling through the floor
